Title: Asset inventory
Requirement: The organization shall maintain an inventory of all cloud resources, including each resource's owner, data classification and region.

Title: Resource tagging
Requirement: The organization shall tag every cloud resource with its owning team and its environment at the time the resource is created.

Title: Federated sign-in
Requirement: All workforce access to the cloud management console shall be authenticated through the organization's central identity provider.

Title: Privileged access review
Requirement: Privileged roles shall be reviewed at least every 90 days, and any privilege that has not been used since the last review shall be revoked.

Title: Encryption at rest
Requirement: Customer data stored in the cloud environment shall be encrypted at rest using encryption keys that the organization itself controls.

Title: Key rotation
Requirement: Encryption keys that protect customer data shall be rotated at least once every twelve months and whenever a compromise is suspected.

Title: Audit logging
Requirement: Administrative actions in the cloud environment shall be logged, and the logs shall be retained for at least one year in storage that administrators cannot alter.
